entries.zh: 培墓（添土修坟，祭扫坟墓）
entries.en: to add earth to a grave / tend and sweep a tomb (grave-tending)

entries.zh: 翻板（整理印刷用的雕板；亦指翻印刻板）
entries.en: to set up / dress the printing blocks; to re-cut or reprint from a block

entries.zh: 三出湯（同一锅汤回锅三次、屡次加热的菜肴）
entries.en: a broth served / reheated three times; thrice-boiled soup

entries.zh: 謎（谜语；猜谜）
entries.en: a riddle; to guess a riddle

entries.zh: 猜看出（看后猜出、推断出来）
entries.en: to guess or make out (by looking); to conjecture rightly

entries.zh: 謎看着（猜谜猜中；谜底被猜着）
entries.en: to guess a riddle and hit it; to guess right

entries.zh: 猜拳（划拳猜枚行酒令）
entries.en: to play the finger-guessing game (pari o noni, mora) at drinking

entries.zh: 謎枚（猜枚：猜单双或枚数）
entries.en: to guess at odd or even (a game of guessing counters)

entries.zh: 謎只猜許（东猜西猜、胡乱猜疑）
entries.en: to guess now this, now that; to conjecture wildly (delirando)
entries.notes: 汉字序列『只/许』在闽南语中作虚词助解，逐字义存推断成分

entries.zh: 謎出了（猜中了、猜出来了）
entries.en: the riddle is solved / guessed right

entries.zh: 主细猜（细细琢磨着猜；留心细猜）
entries.en: to guess cautiously / by trying carefully (con tiento)
entries.notes: 词头『主细』对『tiento（谨慎试探）』为意译对应，展开依赖推断

entries.zh: 约（猜约、估猜；亦含约定义）
entries.en: to guess / conjecture by way of play; to wager a guess
entries.notes: 西语『xuegando como aportando（如打赌般猜）』与『约』的单字对应稍间接

entries.zh: 约拳（猜拳，赌拳猜枚）
entries.en: to play guessing-fingers (pari o noni) as a wager

entries.zh: 约定（约定、预先说定；封存件标注[acertar]或为猜中义）
entries.en: to agree upon / fix beforehand (blind note glosses: to hit upon, guess right)
entries.notes: 封存件西语栏带方括号补注[acertar]，与汉字『约定』义有出入，存疑

entries.zh: 卜（占卜、卜问吉凶）
entries.en: to divine, to cast lots / practice divination

entries.zh: 卜卦（起卦占卜）
entries.en: to divine by casting the hexagram / draw a lot

entries.zh: 詎（料度逆料；猜着料中）
entries.en: to conjecture and hit; to reckon beforehand (guess right)
entries.notes: 汉字『詎』罕见作此用，官话对音 qūi 亦异于常读，展开依赖推断

entries.zh: 詎料（岂料、逆料；料想到）
entries.en: to reckon beforehand / guess (what will happen); who would have thought
entries.notes: 『詎料』今多作反诘『岂料』，此处按 adivinar acertando 取料中义

entries.zh: 占（占卜、占卦）
entries.en: to divine, to practice divination

entries.zh: 占卜（占卦问卜）
entries.en: to divine by lot / augury

entries.zh: 占台官（占验官员；如所说那位国王的占星官/预言者）
entries.en: a diviner / court soothsayer or astrologer (as they say the King has)
entries.notes: 『台』字或为『太/天』之形误或官职称呼，M 栏附 muel coroh 提示另有考语，展开依赖推断

entries.zh: 完籤（求签抽签问卜；签占）
entries.en: to draw divining lots (bamboo divination slips) / divine by lot-drawing
entries.notes: 汉字『完』与抽签义衔接欠直，或为『求/挽』之类写异，存疑
